# Asset attribution

Every non-code asset in this repository (images, icons, fonts, example files, presets) is
listed here with its author, source and licence. `cargo xtask assets` (part of
`cargo xtask ci`) fails if an asset file is missing from this table.

**Policy (mandatory):** Cresard Tables contains **no Microsoft, Adobe, Avid, Autodesk or
other vendor's iconography, images, artwork, fonts, templates, themes, table styles or
sample files**. Every asset is original work by Cresard Desk, or third-party material under
an open licence (OSI open source, public domain / CC0, or Creative Commons that allows
redistribution). Screenshots of other vendors' software are never committed. Font files are
not added here: shared fonts live in the optional `craft-fonts` input (`CRAFT_FONTS_DIR`).

Generated-in-code art is original and has no file to list: the UI icon set
(`crates/ui-egui/src/icons.rs`), themes (`crates/engine/src/cmd/view.rs`), cell styles
(`crates/engine/src/cmd/format.rs`), table styles (`crates/engine/src/tables.rs`), chart
palettes and the sample workbooks (`crates/engine/src/sample.rs`).

## Screenshots

Every picture in `docs/images/` is a capture of Cresard Tables itself, taken with its own control
channel (`ui.screenshot`) from the Windows build on a headless-sized window. They contain no other
software's interface and no third-party artwork.

| Asset | Author | Source | Licence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `docs/images/hero-sales.png` | Cresard Desk | `--sample sales` with `ui.set {dark:false}`, captured via `ui.screenshot` | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Quarterly Sales Dashboard, light chrome |
| `docs/images/dark-sales.png` | Cresard Desk | the same view with `ui.set {dark:true}` | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | The same dashboard in dark mode: the chrome darkens and the sheet keeps its paper colour |
| `docs/images/budget.png` | Cresard Desk | `--sample budget` with `ui.set {dark:false}`, captured via `ui.screenshot` | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Household budget: accounting formats, colour scales, bar chart |
| `docs/images/grades-formulas.png` | Cresard Desk | `--sample grades` with `ui.set {dark:false}` and `ui.ribbon {tab:"Formulas"}`, captured via `ui.screenshot` | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | Gradebook: IFS, data bars, function library |

Each capture asks for its own theme before it shoots. A fresh window follows the system
appearance, so a screenshot that does not is a picture of whatever machine happened to take it —
which is how the light and the dark shot once ended up as the same file.

Cresard Tables is a rebranded distribution of GridCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0, Copyright (c)
2026 ArtCraft Team and the GridCraft contributors). Every non-brand file in this repository
